interpretation: Mixed source paragraphs are retained verbatim; supported entries mean internal data/evidence representation only, not full business-rule enforcement. The requirement-level cross-cutting matrix separates external integrations, policy supersession and business decisions. All page numbers are unverified, never invented.

processes.name: Packaging / Artwork
processes.choices: Direct/Pitch changes research and creative procurement. Format, pack components and target-market choices are recorded. Executable V2 scope is internal evidence only.

stages.name: Stage 1 – Project Inquiry (Brief)

sourceRequirements.text: Stage 1 – Project Inquiry (Brief)
Goal: capture what is being made, for whom, by when and for how much.

Data: client and final beneficiaries; brand, sub-brand, variants / SKUs; stick format (KS, Slims, Super Slims, Queens, Nano, HnB) and pack type; components (primary pack, inner frame, inner bundle foil, tipping paper, outer carton, mastercarton); target market(s); external / internal execution; Direct or Pitch; budget; request date; market launch date; priority; initial brief; key business objectives; legal notes.
Actions: fill the form; draft Creative Brief – Packaging from the template.
Done when: all required fields filled; brief draft exists.

stages.name: Stage 2 – Research & Planning

sourceRequirements.text: Stage 2 – Research & Planning
Goal: know the rules and the resources before any design starts.

Data: market regulations (health warning type and size, languages, tax stamp, track & trace, bans on fruit imagery or flavour names, tar/nicotine declaration position); competitor packs; printer capabilities and finishes; technical drawings (dielines); previous projects of the brand.

Actions: complete the "Market regulatory requirements" document; collect dielines; Pitch only: Director selects participants, brief and Pitch Terms sent after Director approval, Q&A, Outline Proposals received and compared (section 13).
Done when: regulatory document complete; brief approved by the Director and sent; Pitch: agency selected and Framework Agreement signed.

stages.name: Stage 6 – Production & Handover

sourceRequirements.text: Stage 6 – Production & Handover
Goal: approve the Final Artwork and hand it to production.
Final Artwork approval chain (fixed order):

Stakeholders approve the PDF preview, in the order set by the PM. Purchase is always in this group; Client representatives (e.g. Sales Director, NPD Lead, GM) and any other stakeholders are added as needed.
CEO.
All Executors of the project: technical and print check of the files.
Director: final approval.
On rejection, the PM chooses from which step the chain restarts after the correction; the Director sees and can change this choice.
Final Artwork from an external vendor cannot be accepted without a signed Copyright Transfer Agreement or Framework Agreement; only the Director can override this.
Actions: production units per final file; production files; handover (internal or external, external only to CERBER-approved vendors, Director approval for production orders).
Done when: every production unit approved and handed over.

stages.name: Stage 8 – Commercialisation (starts after stage 7 is closed)

sourceRequirements.text: Stage 8 – Commercialisation (starts after stage 7 is closed)
Goal: equip Sales with product data and a marketing toolkit.

Product Card for Toolio (mostly pre-filled from stages 1 and 5): brand, variant, SKU, EAN codes (pack, outer, mastercarton), markets and registrations; stick length, diameter, filter type, tar / nicotine / CO per market, sticks per pack; pack type, packs per outer, outers per mastercarton, dimensions, weights, pallet configuration; price category, launch date; short description, USP, target group (adult smokers of legal age only), slogan; packshots of pack, stick, outer, mastercarton. Approved by the Owner only. Entered into Toolio manually by the Digital Lead (currently Vinu Vinayan) via a task, confirmed with "Entered in Toolio".

Product Marketing Toolkit (Keynote / PowerPoint / PDF): cover; moodboard and product slogan; primary pack visualisation (front, back, sides, 3D); single tobacco stick; outer and mastercarton; 1–2 pages of concept promotional materials (Key Visual, T-shirt, plastic bag, mini stand, poster, etc.); short specification page. Concept pages carry the default note "Concept visualisation – internal / trade use only", which only the Director can remove. Approved by the Director only.

Questions shown to the PM when the stage opens: new SKU or refresh (new card or update)? Full or short toolkit? Formats and languages? Deadline (e.g. distributor meeting)? Made internally or by an agency (then brief, RFP and copyright transfer apply)?
Each concept promotional item in the toolkit can start a new project from the POSM & Promo template.
Done when: Product Card approved and entered in Toolio; Toolkit approved by the Director. The project closes when stages 7 and 8 are complete.

crossCuttingCoverage.coverageAndLimits: Six scalar types, requiredness/defaults/bounds/select/date validation. No repeated rows, conditional rules, cross-field consistency or master SKU/format library.
Bounded count and MIME/extension declarations, sealed exact versions, independent review. Unlimited uploads/all formats, automatic previews and arbitrary-field attachments are not available.
Required human attestations plus text or stage-file evidence. Does not inspect artwork internals, legal compliance or real-world acceptance.
Fixed ordered Director/SPM/Owner/Co-owner eligibility and evidence snapshots. Purchase/CEO/arbitrary stakeholders/all Executors and chosen-step restart need new capabilities.
AND of required fields/checklists, accepted files, approvals and explicit predecessor stages. No task, external-state, conditional branch, skip or override gate.
Genuine Director publication, immutable definition/hash/history, future revisions cannot retarget existing projects. No official standard catalog designation exists.
Real version-pinned identity, typed evidence, explicit stage completion and immutable completed history; no hardcoded template stage count.

All six existing types and Sisters in real runtime context; file/data target adapters with reauthorization and exact provenance; concept inspiration. Source forwarding/planned tasks/mandatory stage link, automatic approval/sample tasks, notifications/calendar and blockers are not implemented.

Explicit Director per-project REQUIRED/OPTIONAL/NOT_APPLICABLE policy for Approval Proof/Copyright Transfer/Invoice; internal exact-version review and final completion. No automatic source-derived requirements, external links or pre-production contract gate.
Native version references, provenance and reauthorized conditional reads; no automatic archive, same-name revision matching or unlimited storage policy.
Typed internal subjects and exact evidence, immutable decisions. No external dispatch subject/token/recipient adapter.
Actual actor/session, native audit and atomic outbox; no external worker/notification delivery implied.

Five V2 roles; no general Collaborator; technical privileges separate; global Director without membership; JPM requires Director plus eligible SPM Co-owner; SPM approved executable version; no skips/overrides/delegation; no task visibility solely from project management.
Initial/Final Concept are Universal Tasker types, not mandatory legacy fixed stages. Source skip rules do not introduce new bypasses.
Owner request and separate Director final decision after approved document policy. No automatic closing/archiving.
Typed vendor identity/status synchronization, approved recipient/version dispatch, contract and order workflow, genuine external actor/access-token/provenance model.
Source calls for manual Digital Lead entry via task. Existing General Tasks can record work; verified Toolio state/completion gate is absent. No automatic integration invented.

Structured comparison, Director-controlled defaults/participants, exact terms acceptance, release sequencing, fees and five-day signed-agreement gate. Source defaults 2 rounds, 5%, 0.5%, USD, 21 days, 30/45 minutes, 4–5 stakeholders and 5 days are recorded, not operational.
Prefilled structured documents, Draft/For approval/Approved/Signed lifecycle, signatures, legal templates and binary preflight. File storage is not document generation or legal approval.
Repeating relational units/rounds/outlets, conditional acceptance, inventory, linked projects, scheduling, test/bug lifecycles and maintenance mode.
Per-vendor offers/commitments/invoices, calculations, visibility-specific ledger, alerts and archive summary; a numeric budget field is capture only.
Backward planning, availability calendars, reminders, account lockouts, delegation, escalation and automatic tasks; no operational service inferred.
Three genuine role-specific ratings per vendor and completion gate; generic checklist cannot enforce.
Detailed types 2–5 fields/checklists/guidance; durations; starter tasks; legal review; CERBER master data/reverification; file-size policy; toolkit master layout. Keep all open.

Global close/archive versus Digital indefinite maintenance; section 17 Acceptance Protocol stage 7 versus six-stage POSM and eight-stage Stand; Packaging stages 7/8 closure versus common ratings. Use business-purpose mapping and V2 final authority, never an invented fixed index.
